description: Unison CV Expander: it spreads two more control signals along the same voice layout as a Unison Helper, and goes immediately to the right of it

inputs.text: Takes a control signal to be spread across the unison voices the parent Unison Helper has laid out.

outputs.text: Carries one input spread for one of the parent's oscillators, channel for channel with the V/Oct that oscillator is being given.

notes: with no Unison Helper to its left the display reads DISCONNECTED and the outputs stay silent; further expanders can be chained beyond this one.
menu: Use Global Style — ties this module's appearance to the setting shared by every Surge XT module, rather than to this module alone.
Skin — sets the panel colouring: Dark, Medium or Light.
Colors — a submenu setting the colour of the Display Area, Knob and Slider Values, Modulations and Power Buttons, and carrying Show Knob Shadows.
